source_snapshot.items: PCIe Retimer Upstream/Downstream Receiver Margin Test
source_snapshot.procedure: Discover AMD BDFs with `lspci -PP`; run verified `amdxio -margin -pcie` with comma-separated BDFs, `ber=10`, `errcnt=5`, receiver 2 for retimer upstream and receiver 3 for downstream; collect results/logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: PASS when result CSV row count equals tested lane count; example 8 OAMs x16 equals 128 rows.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; incorrectly assumes a mandatory external protocol analyzer despite the Master specifying a local amdxio command.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/CRITICAL under the same unproven analyzer assumption, but also identifies topology, receiver separation and safety needs.

old_problem: The historical review left the case Pending because DeepSeek/GPT imported an external-analyzer requirement absent from the source, treated BDF/lane mapping as a decision instead of runtime configuration and asked whether unstated margin thresholds were required. It correctly noted that total row count alone can conceal duplicated/missing lane identities and that log clearing would destroy evidence.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict through the explicit Master method plus AMD documentation showing `amdxio -margin -pcie` is a software margining command. No authoritative source requires an external analyzer for this row. ED-03 permits a package-gated draft and ED-07/ED-19 preserve the separate upstream/downstream identity. Exact BDF/lane topology, binary version and receiver support are runtime prerequisites. The literal PASS contract is dataset completeness: exact unique lane set/count per CSV. Because no numeric margin threshold is supplied, the test must retain all margin values but cannot claim signal-integrity quality from them.
decision_basis: XLSX row 1973, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, ED-01 through ED-30 and AMD technical documentation were read; the actual next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 1974 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00140-V003 / 8f34f9fa74baadc1.

The Master explicitly defines a local `amdxio -margin -pcie` workflow and receiver 2/3 roles; AMD release documentation independently confirms `amdxio -margin -pcie` as a supported software command family.
Neither the Master nor researched AMD authority states that a protocol analyzer is mandatory, so DeepSeek's physical-hardware substitution cannot control classification.
BDFs, retimer ports, negotiated widths and expected lane IDs are project configuration that can be bound in a signed run manifest without leaving the review Pending.

The only source PASS rule is lane-result completeness. Unique lane identity plus count closes the duplicate/omission gap, while absent margin thresholds mean values are evidence only and no quality PASS may be invented.
The source's log-clear step is replaced by timestamped pre/post deltas under ED-17; no lspci, amdxio, margining, log clear, analyzer, PCIe/GPU or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Separate amdxio PCIe retimer upstream/downstream receiver margin dataset completeness
test_case.purpose: Using the approved amdxio build and exact topology manifest, collect separate receiver-2 upstream and receiver-3 downstream margin CSVs for every intended retimer lane and prove complete unique lane coverage without inventing a margin-quality threshold.
required_package: Exact SUT/OAM/root-port/retimer firmware and BDF-to-port-to-lane topology, negotiated width/speed and expected unique lane set per run
Approved amdxio binary version/path/checksum plus matching AMD/platform recipe confirming `-margin -pcie`, `-bdf`, `-ber=10`, `-errcnt=5` and receiver 2/3 support
Two signed immutable run manifests: receiver=2 upstream BDF/lane set and receiver=3 downstream BDF/lane set
Maintenance approval, idle GPU/PCIe workload, independent console and link-recovery/escalation path
Raw stdout/stderr/CSV hashing, timestamped pre/post lspci/link/AER/dmesg/syslog/SEL evidence and parser version
test_case.test_command: PACKAGE-GATED; first preserve rather than clear timestamped PCIe topology, negotiated width/speed, AER and system/BMC log baselines. Verify the amdxio checksum/help against the approved recipe and reconcile every `lspci -PP` BDF to the signed retimer/lane manifest. After explicit approval, run one bounded receiver=2 command for its exact BDF set and one separate bounded receiver=3 command for its exact BDF set using `-margin -pcie -ber=10 -errcnt=5`; never combine outputs. Hash stdout/stderr and raw CSVs, then compare each CSV's unique `(target,port,lane,receiver)` identities and row count with its expected set. Preserve all margin values without grading them. Stop on mismatch, link loss/downtrain, AER/error burst or tool fault; do not clear logs, attach unapproved hardware, guess mappings or automatically retry.
test_case.expected_result: Each approved upstream and downstream run completes once, produces its own parseable immutable CSV, and contains exactly one result for every expected unique lane identity and no unexpected/duplicate row; pre/post links retain approved width/speed and show no new disallowed errors. Margin values are retained for engineering analysis but receive no PASS threshold in this row.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved tool/topology, successful separate receiver=2 and receiver=3 runs, exact expected unique lane sets/counts (including the source 8x16=128 example only when that topology applies), no duplicates/unexpected lanes, and healthy post-link/log deltas. FAIL on missing/duplicate/unexpected lane, wrong receiver/BDF, command/CSV error, link regression or disallowed new error. No margin-value quality PASS/FAIL is permitted without a separately approved threshold; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Require signed topology/receiver manifests, verified binary/recipe, maintenance approval and idle links before margining.
Preserve logs and evidence; prohibit dmesg/syslog/SEL clearing and unapproved analyzer/fixture attachment.
Execute receiver 2 and 3 separately and once; stop on wrong target, link loss/downtrain, AER/error burst, tool incompatibility or unexpected state.
No automatic retry or invented margin threshold; retain first-failure artifacts and use the approved console/link recovery path.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant and SUT/OAM/retimer/firmware/driver/tool checksum identities
Signed BDF/port/receiver/lane manifests plus pre/post topology, width/speed and AER/log baselines
Exact separate receiver=2 and receiver=3 commands, status, stdout/stderr and raw CSV hashes
Expected-versus-observed unique lane-set/count/duplicate report for each direction
All ungraded margin values, post-run health, no-clear/no-retry/no-analyzer audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On tool error, wrong target, missing/duplicate lane, link loss/downtrain or new AER/system fault, stop without rerun and preserve the first outputs plus current PCIe/log state. Do not clear errors or change receiver/BDF guesses. Use the approved independent console and platform PCIe recovery path; quarantine affected links/OAMs until the PCIe owner reviews the evidence.

source_conflict.reason: The explicit Master amdxio software workflow and AMD documentation outweigh the unsupported analyzer-only assumption; acceptance is exactly unique lane-data completeness, not an unstated signal-quality threshold.

blocked.reason: Tool, topology, safety, evidence and completeness oracle are defined; exact package/BDF/lane bindings are runtime Project Configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Approved amdxio build/recipe, exact BDF-retimer-port-lane/receiver manifests, expected per-run unique lane sets, maintenance/recovery and evidence policy.

external_authorities.title: AMD Instinct Software Release Notes — PCIe margining known-issue guidance
external_authorities.application: AMD documents `./amdxio -margin -pcie` as the software command used for PCIe retimer margining, disproving an assumed mandatory external analyzer.

external_authorities.title: AMD Family 19h Models 10h-1Fh Revision Guide 57095
external_authorities.application: Documents PCIe retimer receiver-margin register behavior and the need for margining software to handle invalid readings, supporting strict raw-data/error preservation.

project_authority: The PCIe/platform owner supplies the exact supported amdxio build and topology/receiver/lane manifests, approves the maintenance window and judges evidence. They cannot import an unapproved analyzer requirement, merge receiver directions, clear logs or claim margin quality without a threshold.
